description: This file implements the measurement configuration management for a DU (Distributed Unit) in a 5G NR network, including unpacking measurement configs, creating measurement gaps based on SSB MTC configs, and updating UE resource configurations.

classes.name: du_meas_config_manager
classes.description: Manages measurement configurations for DU, including updating UE configs based on received measurement config data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates UE resource configuration with new measurement configuration data, creating measurement gaps as needed.
